summary: FP4-CSF checkpoints load again in the canonical image instead of failing with No module named 'b12x.loader._csf_source'
compatibility: No user action required. Canonical images karmic-kraken-20261012 and karmic-kraken-20261013 cannot load CSF checkpoints; this image loads them as karmic-kraken-20261011 did.
details: Canonical vLLM commits 84c0704f8f and 3a947437cf moved CSF scale loading to b12x.loader._csf_source and b12x.loader._csf_blocks. The FlashInfer build in the image does not ship those modules, so every CSF checkpoint failed at load with ModuleNotFoundError.
Both commits are reverted, so the CSF loader is again the one from karmic-kraken-20261011. The block CSF format can return together with a FlashInfer build that ships those modules.
